content.text: Use edit_file to create numbers.txt containing the numbers 1 to 300, one per line. Do not explain, just call the tool.

system.text: You are a coding agent working in a folder. Use the tools to search, read and edit files there and to run commands. Paths are relative to that folder.

tools.description: Read a text file in the working folder. Lines come back numbered from 1, as `<number>\t<line>`. Reads up to 2000 lines unless `limit` says otherwise, and at most 50000 bytes; use `offset` to continue. Lines over 2000 characters are cut.

path.description: Path relative to the working folder

tools.name: read_file

tools.description: Replace `old_string` with `new_string` in a file in the working folder. `old_string` must match the file exactly, whitespace included, and must occur exactly once; include surrounding lines to make it unique. To create a file, or fill an empty one, give an empty `old_string`.

new_string.description: Text to put in its place

path.description: Path relative to the working folder

tools.name: edit_file

tools.description: Run a command with `sh -c` in the working folder and return its exit code, stdout and stderr. A non-zero exit code is reported, not treated as a failure. Each stream keeps its last 2000 lines or 50000 bytes. The command is done when its process exits; a background job (`&`) keeps running and its later output is not returned. The command is killed after `timeout_secs` (default 120, at most 600). There is no terminal and no stdin.
tools.name: shell

tools.description: Search the working folder. With `pattern` (a regex), returns matching lines as `path:line:text`. With only `glob`, lists matching files. With both, searches only files matching `glob`. A glob without `/` matches file names anywhere; with `/` it matches the path from the working folder, e.g. `src/**/*.rs`. Hidden files and paths in `.gitignore` are skipped. At most 500 results.

glob.description: Glob that file paths must match

path.description: Folder to search, relative to the working folder; defaults to all of it

pattern.description: Regex to find in file contents

tools.name: search
